news.title: UW–Madison chancellor special regent committee announces three finalists
news.summary_en: Candidate interviews and forums will be held on the UW–Madison campus next week.

news.title: Hope for the critically endangered northern muriqui monkey
news.summary_en: A new grant is providing $1 million over five years to go directly toward the conservation of Brazil’s peaceful primate population, and UW–Madison researcher Karen Strier will be leading the effort.

news.title: UW’s Nobel laureate started his research with a question
news.summary_en: In an opinion piece for the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel, interim Chancellor Eric Wilcots makes the case for giving researchers the resources necessary to pursue answers to curiosity-driven questions.

news.title: A campus to fall for
news.summary_en: Take in autumn at UW–Madison, where Badgers welcome brisk days and burnished views.

news.title: Learning and earning: Another banner academic year for UW–Madison degree recipients
news.summary_en: The university awarded a record number of degrees during the 2025-26 academic year, with students earning an undergraduate degree at the fastest pace ever.

news.title: UW–Madison information about Nov. 3 Crime Warning
news.summary_en: UW-Madison is investigating anonymous reports of drugging that were received by the university.

news.title: Remembering educator, advocate and philanthropist Tashia Morgridge
news.summary_en: A former teacher and advocate for literacy, Tashia Morgridge was one of UW–Madison’s most generous supporters. Her philanthropy will affect Badgers for generations.

news.title: UW–Madison ranked No. 11 for ‘best value’ among public schools
news.summary_en: Princeton Review also places the university at No. 5 for financial aid and among top 20 for career placement, alumni networks and service impact.

news.title: Search begins for CALS dean
news.summary_en: Members of the UW–Madison community can give input to the search committee through an online survey or at public listening sessions on Nov. 18 and 19.

news.title: Save the dates: UW–Madison chancellor finalist presentations
news.summary_en: Faculty, staff and students, as well as alumni and members of the public, are encouraged to attend the sessions the week of Nov. 9.

news.title: Robert George, Cornel West: Truth-seeking starts with admitting you might be wrong
news.summary_en: Visiting UW–Madison, the two scholars and close friends from opposite ends of the political spectrum make the case for talking it out.
